title: The Spirit and Resurrection
definition: The Spirit and resurrection refers to the Holy Spirit's life-giving work in raising Christ and guaranteeing resurrection life for believers.
summary: The Spirit gives resurrection life now and will give life to believers' mortal bodies.
christFocus: Jesus was raised in victory, and the Spirit applies resurrection hope to His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is connected to resurrection life. Scripture teaches that the Spirit who raised Jesus will also give life to believers' mortal bodies.

This means Christian hope is not only spiritual comfort but bodily resurrection. The Spirit is the guarantee of future life and the giver of new life now.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Death and bodily weakness can make hope feel fragile. This doctrine matters because the Spirit points believers to the final victory of life in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set your hope on resurrection. Let the Spirit strengthen you to endure suffering and live now in the power of Christ's risen life.

relatedTopics: Resurrection, Ascension, and Return of Christ
